result.reason: The redline does not reach either the preferred or fallback position. It leaves the licence unavailable to affiliates and contractors, and retains the non-transferable and non-assignable restrictions without an M&A successor exception. It also permits termination under Section 4 generally rather than only for uncured material breach, and does not address perpetual treatment for any paid-up licence. Although the amendment is narrow and preserves unrelated commercial terms, it is incomplete, and the blank defined term identified in the margin comment remains unfixed.
